answer: Persistent Attention Ledger. Each identity must keep a live review queue that decays unless it consumes fresh, non-replicable work; every action posts a mirror of that history. Rewards are nectar accrued only while the queue stays current. The vault holds payouts until 30 days of uninterrupted maintenance passes. An attacker running N identities pays N times the daily labor and forfeits it on any lapse.
